assets.author: Daniel Greenheck
assets.changes: Offline low-poly EZ-Tree preset. Natural branching and photographic alpha leaf clusters; 512px colour and 256px bark normals. Spatially partitioned paired leaf cards; nested source anchors and local leaf-area compensation across LODs. Continuous ellipsoid envelope normals; original card normals retained as _LEAF_NORMAL for two-sided transmission. Bounded canopy-volume access approximation, not ray-traced AO. Generator and source archive are not shipped.
